notes:
=== PART 2 - NATIONAL RULES (all verified on BOE consolidated texts unless stated) ===

(a) ACCESS TO A SPANISH GRADO WITH A FOREIGN (non-EU) BACHELOR'S DEGREE
1. RD 534/2024 (BOE 12/06/2024; consolidated text last modified 02/07/2026), Art. 7: may access grado directly: "a) Quienes estén en posesión de un título universitario oficial de Grado, Máster o título equivalente." ... "d) Quienes hayan cursado estudios universitarios parciales extranjeros o quienes, habiendo finalizado los estudios universitarios extranjeros, no hayan obtenido su homologación o declaración de equivalencia en España y deseen continuar estudios en una universidad española. En este supuesto, será requisito indispensable que la universidad en la que quieran continuar estudios les haya reconocido al menos 30 créditos ECTS."
2. GRADUATE QUOTA - Art. 43: "Para quienes ya estén en posesión de una titulación universitaria oficial o equivalente, se reservará un número de plazas no inferior al 1 por ciento, ni superior al 3 por ciento." Art. 38.1: the reserve percentages of arts. 39-43 apply to the places offered by PUBLIC universities; Art. 38.2: unfilled reserved places go to the general quota "en cada una de las convocatorias de admisión". Art. 45.2: foreign graduates WITH homologation/equivalence are treated like Spanish graduates (Art. 7 a/b), average grade via Ministry equivalence tables. => A foreign degree must be HOMOLOGATED or DECLARED EQUIVALENT before using the graduate quota. Confirmed for the Madrid district by UAH: foreign-system university graduates "deben haber obtenido la homologación o declaración de equivalencia del nivel académico de Grado/Máster por parte del Ministerio" (uah.es procedimientos-preinscripcion). CETT-UB says the same (homologate/equivalence, then pre-enrolment).
3. >=30 ECTS ROUTE (outside the general procedure) - Art. 45.3: "El Rector o la Rectora de la universidad resolverá las solicitudes de plaza de estudiantes con estudios universitarios extranjeros parciales o totales que no hayan obtenido la homologación o equivalencia ... a) ... a los que se reconozca un mínimo de 30 créditos ECTS serán resueltas de acuerdo con los criterios que establezca el Consejo de Gobierno que, en todo caso, tendrán en cuenta el expediente universitario." Art. 45.4: without 30 ECTS -> same conditions as students without university studies from the same system (i.e., secondary-school route: UNEDasiss/homologated bachillerato). This route is decided by each university (windows found: UPM 26 Jan-10 Mar 2026; URJC 2 Mar-30 Apr 2026, max 1% of places; UCM 14 Apr-14 May 2026; UAM 25 Jun-6 Jul 2026; UC3M 16 Jan-6 Mar 2026; US 1 May-31 Jul; all for SEPTEMBER start). Comunidad de Madrid page (upd. 03/06/2026): such requests "serán resueltas por el Rector de la Universidad", lodged at the "secretaría de la Facultad o Escuela". For a Business Computing graduate this is the realistic route into a CS/IT/Business grado (e.g., basic-training credits), but it requires the degree NOT to have been homologated (US form: declaration that homologation was not requested, or was denied on non-excluded grounds).
4. HOMOLOGACIÓN / EQUIVALENCIA - RD 889/2022 (BOE-A-2022-17045, no modifications). Art. 5.2: equivalence has "efectos académicos y administrativos correspondientes al nivel académico" from issue of the certificate. Art. 18.3: "La resolución se dictará y notificará en el plazo máximo de seis meses, desde la fecha en que la solicitud haya tenido entrada en el registro electrónico. Transcurrido dicho plazo sin haberse notificado la resolución, la solicitud se podrá entender desestimada por silencio administrativo." => Not obtainable in time for a December 2026 letter unless already in hand. Ministry page: equivalence "sirve para continuar estudios, si la universidad lo requiere" (actual average processing times NOT FOUND on official pages).
5. UNEDasiss: the ACREDITACIÓN is the current digital certificate for applicants from foreign SECONDARY systems (includes access grade, PCE grades); the old "credencial" was the pre-2017 EU access credential (FAQ A.8: "If you have an EU Access credential issued before 2017, request a UNEDasiss Accreditation"). For non-EU systems the accreditation requires homologation of the secondary title to Spanish Bachillerato (FAQ A.4). Requests "from the month of February through the month of November". UNEDasiss does NOT handle university-level studies; graduates use homologation/equivalence (quota) or the 30-ECTS route at the university.

(b) STUDENT VISA / STAY FOR STUDIES - RD 1155/2024 (in force 20 May 2025; consolidated text last modified 22/09/2026)
- Art. 52.1.a: higher studies "como actividad principal, en una institución o centro de enseñanza superior reconocido en España, en el marco de un programa a tiempo completo, que conduzca a la obtención de un título de educación superior reconocido". Títulos propios are ALSO included; university studies may be "presencial o híbrida". No rule excludes a second bachelor's; an official grado listed in RUCT clearly qualifies (the centre may be checked in RUCT).
- Art. 52.2 FULL-TIME: "aquel en el que el estudiante se haya matriculado al menos en el noventa por ciento de los créditos en el caso de estudios universitarios". RISK for February entrants who can only enrol in 2nd-semester subjects (~30 ECTS): no official clarification found on how 90% is computed for a mid-year start.
- Art. 53.1.a REQUIREMENTS: "1.º Haber sido admitido por una institución o un centro de enseñanza superior reconocido ... 2.º Haber abonado los derechos de inscripción, matrícula o documento equivalente exigidos por la institución". => An admission letter WITHOUT any payment is not enough under the regulation. Consulates: Chicago (page 30/06/2026): "documents that certify admission and payment of enrollment fees" and "Partial payment of enrollment or tuition fees is sufficient"; Nador: "admisión definitiva ... (no es válida la mera reserva de plaza)" + "Justificación de haber abonado la tasa o coste de la matrícula"; Casablanca (Jan 2025, pre-RD 1155): "SIN EL PAGO DE LA MATRICULA NO SE RECOGERA EL VISADO"; Bogotá/México: "admisión y el pago de la matrícula".
- TIMING: Art. 36.1 and 54.2: visa application "con una antelación mínima de dos meses a la fecha del comienzo de la actividad o estudios", unless justified. Chicago consulate: "Applications must be submitted between 6 months and at least 2 months prior the start of the program" (no 90-day rule found in official sources). For a start in early Feb 2027 the latest normal filing date is early Dec 2026 - consistent with the early-December letter target.
- PROCESSING: Art. 36.3: the Oficina de Extranjería resolves the stay authorisation within 7 days (silence = refusal); Art. 36.4: consulate issues the visa "en el plazo máximo de un mes" after a favourable resolution. Chicago: allow at least 4 weeks; Nador: "38 días"; São Paulo form: national visas generally 1 month.
- FROM INSIDE SPAIN: Art. 54.1: for higher studies the application "también podrá presentarse en España por la persona extranjera siempre que se encuentre regularmente en territorio nacional", adult, at least 2 months before the start; Art. 54.3: resolution within 2 months (silence = refusal); Art. 54.6: institutions in the Registro de Instituciones y Centros de Enseñanza Superior may file electronically, 15-day resolution. (Consular note, Nador: a Schengen visa will not be issued if the purpose is to avoid the consular study-visa route.)
- MEANS & OTHER: Art. 35.h: 100% IPREM per month (unless accommodation prepaid) - study costs not counted; health insurance with an insurer authorised in Spain; criminal record (stays >6 months); medical certificate; passport valid >=1 year. Art. 55.1: authorisation lasts the official duration of the studies; annual proof of enrolment (Art. 55.2). TIE within 1 month of entry (Art. 34.3).
- inclusion.gob.es 'Hoja informativa - estancia por estudios' returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; the BOE text was used instead.

(c) REFUNDS IF VISA REFUSED - no official Spanish rule specific to visa refusal was found. General consumer law (RDLeg 1/2007 TRLGDCU, consolidated 28/02/2026): Art. 87.2 abusive clause: "La retención de cantidades abonadas por el consumidor y usuario por renuncia, sin contemplar la indemnización por una cantidad equivalente si renuncia el empresario"; Art. 87.6 also covers "la pérdida de las cantidades abonadas por adelantado". Art. 102: 14-day withdrawal right for distance/off-premises contracts (exceptions Art. 103; does not apply to public prices). Public universities' fees are public prices: UC3M 70 EUR study fee non-refundable "salvo causas imputables a la Universidad"; UAH "No se admiten devoluciones excepto por causas imputables a la administración". Visa fee itself is not refunded on refusal (visa form: "la denegación del visado no da lugar al reembolso de los gastos de tramitación del visado"). Non-official lead: a 2020 Audiencia Provincial de Málaga ruling (blog commentary) refused a 3,000 EUR master reservation refund where the student could not attend for immigration reasons - so get the refund-on-visa-refusal clause IN WRITING before paying.

=== MADRID PUBLIC PRICES (context) ===
Decreto 43/2022 (Comunidad de Madrid) applies. Non-EU students over 18 without residence pay "los precios de cuarta matrícula" for grado; "la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes" (comunidad.madrid page upd. 28/04/2026, showing curso 2025-26; URJC 2026/27 page). URJC 2026/27 grado per-credit: 1st enrolment 20,68 / 19,43 / 16,92 EUR (experimentality 1/2/3); 4th+ enrolment 136,44 / 128,57 / 113,71 EUR => non-EU non-resident approx. 60 x 113,71 = 6.822,60 EUR to 60 x 136,44 = 8.186,40 EUR per year (arithmetic from official per-credit prices; URJC page still cites RD 557/2011). Fees: study of recognition/convalidation from foreign centres 70 EUR; apertura de expediente 27,54 EUR.

=== KEY CONCLUSION FOR THIS GROUP ===
No Madrid public university (UC3M, UAM, UAH, UPM, UCM, URJC) and not Universidad de Sevilla or EUSA offers a February/second-semester start for new or transfer grado students - all windows (Jan-July) lead to a SEPTEMBER start. UC3M has the largest English-taught grado offer but only for September. The only public-university second-semester intake found outside Catalonia is Universidad de León (Spanish-taught; admission window 8-22 Jan 2027 - too late for the visa). The Catalan "preinscripció de febrer" (Generalitat; Feb 2026 list) includes ENGLISH-taught official grados at public-affiliated centres (CETT-UB Tourism 100% English; ESIC-URV Marketing in English; UAB-affiliated Tourism in English) plus private UVic-UCC 'Estudis Globals / Global Studies (docència en Anglès)' and public UdL 'Estudis Anglesos' (5 places) - but the convocation takes place 2-4 Feb (2026 cycle), i.e., after the visa deadline; these are recorded as UNCLEAR programs/leads for the Catalonia group to verify for 2027. No French-taught or Franco-Spanish grado with February entry was found.
False lead: Universidad de Zaragoza February 'Fase 3' = doctorate only. CEU Andalucía (Bormujos) now operates as Universidad CEU Fernando III (private) - not checked here (private-university group).
